_note: Static country-level markers for networks with no physical station pins. Consumed by index.html alongside stations.json. Three tiers: 'vrs' (in-pipeline VRS-only, coloured circle), 'deferred' (free network not yet ingested, grey circle), 'info' (paid or restricted, circled ?). VRS entries use source_id to look up color and registration URL from stations.json at runtime. Replaces the pins:false subset of VRS_NETWORKS in index.html — frontend migration pending.

markers.name: ReNEP
markers.note: 47 stations, free. Endpoint disclosed only after account approval — register at renep.dgterritorio.gov.pt.

markers.name: LitPOS
markers.note: 35 stations, free (publicly-funded EUPOS member). NTRIP host:port not publicly listed — register at geoportal.lt/web/litpos-en to obtain.

markers.name: ZAKPOS
markers.note: ~50 stations; was free. Service disrupted since Feb 2022 invasion. Status unknown — do not rely on.

markers.name: GPSBru / AGN
markers.note: Single station at Uccle observatory, free. Port unconfirmed. Useful only within ~30 km of Brussels.

markers.name: UGRF CORS
markers.note: 78 stations, free as of 2024. Endpoint disclosed only post-registration at ugrf.go.ug.

markers.name: ETCORS
markers.note: ~10 stations, intended free. Launched Dec 2025 by SSGI; NTRIP endpoint not yet publicly discoverable.

markers.name: DOL LandGNSS
markers.note: Free government service. Host:port not found in public aggregators; manual available in Thai at dol-rtknetwork.com.

markers.name: TPOS
markers.note: 11 stations, free. Endpoint disclosed only after account approval at tpos.provincia.tn.it.

markers.name: STPOS
markers.note: 10 stations, free. Endpoint disclosed only after account approval at stpos.it.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Veneto
markers.note: ~20 stations, free on request. Endpoint not publicly listed — contact via retegnssveneto.cisas.unipd.it.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Liguria
markers.note: 10 stations, free. Endpoint not publicly listed — contact via geoportal.regione.liguria.it.

markers.name: Sicili@net
markers.note: ~80 stations (INGV Catania seismic network), free registration. Endpoint not publicly listed.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Molise
markers.note: ~4 stations. NTRIP delivery unconfirmed — contact regione.molise.it.

markers.name: ACORN
markers.note: Free-intended Alaska CORS network (Alaska DOT/PF). NTRIP endpoint not confirmed from public sources.

markers.name: REMOS
markers.note: Government RTK service (IGVSB, 27 NTRIP-capable stations). No public endpoint confirmed — operational status uncertain given infrastructure constraints. Free if accessible.

markers.name: HEPOS
markers.note: ~€160/3 months — worth considering for seasonal use. Subscribe at ktimatologio.gr.

markers.name: ROMPOS
markers.note: ~€169/yr — under the cost of a capable base station. Subscribe at rompos.ro.

markers.name: swipos
markers.note: CHF 1,500/yr. At this price a local base station is likely more practical. Volunteer rtk2go/Centipede bases provide partial free coverage.

markers.name: CPOS / ETPOS
markers.note: NOK 8,000+/yr via kartverket.no. Volunteer rtk2go/Centipede bases exist in populated areas (Oslofjord, Vestlandet).

markers.name: SIGNAL
markers.note: €829/yr (€622 early discount) via gu-signal.si. Volunteer rtk2go/Centipede bases provide partial free coverage.

markers.name: SWEPOS Network RTK
markers.note: ~SEK 9,000/yr via lantmateriet.se. Free DGNSS tier available but sub-metre only (out of scope).

markers.name: SiReNT
markers.note: SGD $107/month via sla.gov.sg. 3-day trial requires SingPass (residents only).

markers.name: MyRTKnet
markers.note: Paid subscription (Survey Act cost-recovery). 78 stations. Contact jupem.gov.my.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif
markers.note: Paid membership + annual fee. Pricing not publicly listed — contact harita.gov.tr.

markers.name: VNGEONET
markers.note: Was free until Aug 2024; fees apply since Sep 2024 per Circular 47/2024/TT-BTC. 65 stations.

markers.name: PAGeNet
markers.note: PHP 1,000 one-time + ongoing subscription (EO 471). 52 stations. Contact namria.gov.ph.

markers.name: GNSSnet.hu
markers.note: Paid; pricing not public. Note: Centipede has ~223 volunteer nodes in Hungary — dense free alternative already on map.

markers.name: AGROS
markers.note: Paid subscription. No English pricing page — contact rgz.gov.rs.

markers.name: MONTEPOS
markers.note: Paid subscription tiers. Contact upco.gov.me.

markers.name: BiHPOS
markers.note: Paid; dual-entity administration (FBiH + RS). Pricing not publicly listed.

markers.name: e-GNSS
markers.note: Pay-per-use + paper form registration (mail/fax). Contact NLSC/MoI via nlsc.gov.tw.

markers.name: CZEPOS
markers.note: Free for education/government; commercial use paid (ČÚZK Decree 31/1995). No general hobbyist path.

markers.name: SKPOS
markers.note: Free for public sector/municipalities; commercial use paid. No general hobbyist path.

markers.name: SoI-CORS
markers.note: Free only for Central/State Government and academic institutions. Private users pay ₹5,032/month (~$720/yr).

markers.name: Réseau GNSS du Québec (MERN)
markers.note: 18 free government CORS stations (Ministère de l'Énergie et des Ressources naturelles). NOT standard NTRIP — each station delivers raw TCP streams (per-station IP:port, CMR+/RTCM 3.2). Standard NTRIP clients won't connect. Technical workaround: use a TCP-capable receiver (e.g. Emlid RS2) or bridge via RTKLIB str2str. Register at mern.gouv.qc.ca.

markers.name: BC RTN
markers.note: Paid regional subscription via GeoBC (gov.bc.ca/geobc). No Canadian province offers free public NTRIP.

markers.name: Nova Scotia NSACS
markers.note: 40-station government CORS network (Nova Scotia Spatial Services). Real-time NRTK only via paid commercial subscriptions: Can-Net/Cansel, HxGN SmartNet, or Brandtnet. Free RINEX archives available via NRCan.

markers.name: SCRTN
markers.note: Paid subscription. Contact SCDOT for pricing (scdot.org).

markers.name: NCRTN
markers.note: ~$500/yr via ncems.org.

markers.name: TDOT RTN
markers.note: ~$450/yr via tn.gov/tdot.

markers.name: TURN GPS
markers.note: ~$600/yr via turngps.org.

markers.name: MTSRN
markers.note: ~$1,500/yr via mdt.mt.gov.

markers.name: WSRN
markers.note: ~$1,900/yr via wsdot.wa.gov. PANGA/CWU contributes Puget Sound antennae and data archiving.

markers.name: CRTN (SOPAC)
markers.note: California Real Time Network at Scripps (UCSD). One-time $100 processing fee — under the $200/yr cutoff. RTCM 3.0 from ~250 stations across California: clearinghouse for SOPAC SCIGN, UC Berkeley/USGS BARD, USGS Pasadena SCIGN, Caltrans CVSRN, Orange County OCRTN, and EarthScope NOTA. Significant overlap with the in-pipeline EarthScope source — same physical antennae, two access paths. Credentials issued in 7+ days.

markers.name: TxDOT CORS
markers.note: TxDOT employees and contractors only. No public or hobbyist registration.

markers.name: CalRTNS
markers.note: Access restricted to vetted state/county agency partners. No general public registration.

markers.name: APN
markers.note: Government NTRIP service (Survey of Israel). Restricted to licensed surveyors. WARNING: pervasive military GNSS spoofing active across Israel and surrounding region since Oct 2023 — RTK unreliable regardless of NTRIP access.

markers.name: IGRS
markers.note: Iraq Geodetic Reference System. Only 7 reference stations at 500–800 km spacing — far too sparse for RTK. No public NTRIP caster; documented for completeness.

markers.name: Pak-Rehber
markers.note: Government NRTK service (SUPARCO). Restricted to authorized users — no public registration or host:port listed. Contact SUPARCO directly (suparco.gov.pk).

markers.name: KazGeoDesy
markers.note: Government CORS network (Committee on Land Management, 120+ stations). Institutional licence or commercial reseller contract required — no self-service registration path.

markers.name: DVRS
markers.note: Dubai Virtual Reference System (Dubai Municipality). 18+ stations, 4-constellation. Professional application only via dm.gov.ae — no general hobbyist registration.

markers.name: REGPMOC
markers.note: Government RTK service (IGN/Ministry of Defence). Professional/commercial licence required — no hobbyist path. Host is known (190.12.71.75:2101) but access requires MoD authorisation.

markers.name: EFT-CORS
markers.note: Hundreds of stations across Russia. GPS+GLONASS+BDS+GAL. 3-day free trial; RINEX data free. Subscribe at eft-cors.ru.

markers.name: RTKNet
markers.note: 300+ stations nationwide. RTCM 3.0 and 3.2-MSM4; 1 Hz. Ports 6030-6041 by federal district. 3-day trial. Subscribe at rtknet.ru.

markers.name: HIVE
markers.note: Pay-per-use: daily RTK or hourly RINEX. Station owners get free caster access. See hive.geosystems.aero.

markers.name: ГЕОСПАЙДЕР
markers.note: 49 stations covering NW Russia centred on St. Petersburg. RTCM 3.1. Monthly/quarterly/annual plans at geospider.ru.

markers.name: 千寻知寸 Qianxun
markers.note: 2,700+ stations across 33 provinces. GPS+GLONASS+BDS+GAL. Individuals register directly — no surveying licence required. Subscribe at qxwz.com.

markers.name: 中国移动CORS
markers.note: 4,400+ stations nationwide. Individual registration available via China Mobile. Largest station count of the three commercial options.

markers.name: Tencent RTK
markers.note: ~2,800+ virtual stations; 33 provinces. WeChat/QQ account required; no surveying licence. Pricing unconfirmed beyond 2022 launch. See lbs.qq.com/rtk.

markers.name: CYPOS
markers.note: Paid subscription tiers (24 h / 1 month / 3 months / 1 year). Contact DLS via portal.dls.moi.gov.cy. 7 stations in government-controlled (southern) area only.

markers.name: GeoNet Bulgaria GEO-RTK
markers.note: Private commercial VRS network. Pricing not published — contact geonet.bg. GCSES (state agency) operates reference stations but provides no public NTRIP caster.

markers.name: KOPOS
markers.note: Kosovo Cadastral Agency GNSS network. 8 CORS, ±2 cm horizontal. Paid subscription. Contact akk.rks-gov.net.

markers.name: ССТП РБ (Belgeodesiya)
markers.note: Organisations only — signed contract with РУП «Белгеодезия» required, no individual self-signup. ~98 CORS nationwide. EU/UK/US sanctions on surveying equipment export (since 2020–2022) add hardware barriers.

markers.name: GeoCors (Georgia)
markers.note: 23 stations (7 Class A + 16 Class B). Leica Spider platform. Subscription required; pricing not public. contact NAPR via geocors.napr.gov.ge.

markers.name: AzPOS
markers.note: ~45 CORS (including 8 restored in Karabakh 2024). Contract required with State Committee on Property Issues — no hobbyist registration path. Contact emlak.gov.az.

markers.name: ARMPOS
markers.note: 12 stations, Norwegian-funded (2013). Licensed surveyors and cadastre users only — no public NTRIP endpoint or hobbyist registration. Contact cadastre.am.

markers.name: KyrPos
markers.note: National GNSS network (ГАЗРКГК). Contract-form signup; credentials issued after signing. Over $200/yr cutoff. Contact gosreg.gov.kg.

markers.name: State Geodesy Committee CORS
markers.note: No public NTRIP endpoint. Government cadastral use. Contact zamin.tj.

markers.name: Mongolia CORS Network
markers.note: 40+ stations (Trimble). Government and licensed surveyor access only. No public NTRIP endpoint. Contact gazar.gov.mn.

markers.name: Turkmenistan National CORS
markers.note: 65-station network (FAO-supported, 2022–2025). Government-internal; no public NTRIP or hobbyist registration path found.

markers.name: IPGN (Iran Permanent GNSS)
markers.note: 127 stations. Registration portal accessible internationally but real-time NTRIP reachability from outside Iran unconfirmed — national internet filtering may block external connections.

markers.name: SHAMIM
markers.note: 144 stations (cadastral). Free for Iranian nationals (national ID required) — inaccessible to foreign users.

markers.name: Directorate of Geographic Affairs (LB)
markers.note: Military directorate, no public NTRIP. Post-2019 financial collapse and 2023–2024 conflict damage. Pervasive GNSS spoofing across southern Lebanon since Oct 2023.

markers.name: RJGC CORS
markers.note: Royal Jordanian Geographic Centre. No public self-service registration; access appears restricted to licensed users. Note: pervasive GNSS spoofing active since Oct 2023 across Israel/Lebanon/Jordan.

markers.name: General Establishment for Survey (SY)
markers.note: No public NTRIP caster found. Pre-war GNSS stations existed but no RTK service deployed. Post-Assad transition (Dec 2024) — sanctions largely lifted but geodetic reconstruction is long-term.

markers.name: REGAT (Algeria)
markers.note: Seismotectonic monitoring network (~53–56 stations) under Ministry of Defence (INCT). No public NTRIP endpoint; hobbyist service structurally unlikely without a separate civilian mandate.

markers.name: Egyptian Survey Authority CORS
markers.note: ~40 stations. Government cadastral/infrastructure use; no streaming NTRIP service publicly announced. Contact esa.gov.eg.

markers.name: Réseau GNSS Permanent ANCFCC
markers.note: ~60 stations (including Laayoune, Dakhla). RTK corrections available but access restricted to licensed cadastral professionals. No public NTRIP endpoint. Contact ancfcc.gov.ma.

markers.name: OTC GNSS Network
markers.note: 23 stations (non-Saharan coverage). RTK via subscription; host:port disclosed after payment. No free tier. Contact otc.nat.tn.

markers.name: Libya Survey Authority CORS
markers.note: No confirmed operational CORS network. Dual-administration since 2014 (GNU/GNS), UN sanctions, and civil conflict make national CORS deployment structurally unlikely in the near term.

markers.name: NIGNET
markers.note: 9–16 physical stations at 500–1,000 km spacing — designed for geodetic reference frame, not RTK. Research NTRIP prototype documented but no stable public endpoint confirmed. Contact osgof.gov.ng.

markers.name: Institut Géographique du Mali CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. Active conflict (April 2026) and AES junta governance make near-term public CORS unlikely. Contact igm-mali.ml.

markers.name: Chad National Geodetic Network
markers.note: IGN FI installed geodetic pillars under RGT20 project (passive survey control, not streaming NTRIP). France ended bilateral programme ties Jan 2025. Contact Ministry of Infrastructure.

markers.name: SEN-CORS
markers.note: ~16 stations planned (PROCASEF/World Bank) + 5 JICA-funded. Physical installation projected late 2025/2026; no public NTRIP host:port yet. Check anat.sn.

markers.name: INC Guinea CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. 2021 coup suspended ECOWAS membership and reduced French bilateral geodetic cooperation. Contact INC via Ministry of Town Planning.

markers.name: DATU Mauritania Geodetic Network
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. Country is ~1 million km² predominantly Saharan — national CORS is a long-term infrastructure prospect. Contact DATU.

markers.name: DGCF Guinea-Bissau
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. No GW station in IGS or AFREF ODC. Contact DGCF.

markers.name: CAR National Mapping Authority
markers.note: No confirmed public CORS network. Near-continuous armed conflict since 2012; Wagner/Africa Corps presence since 2018. No CF station in IGS Network or AFREF ODC.

markers.name: IGEBU CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. JICA technology transfer completed 2010; no evidence of operational CORS streaming. Contact igebu.bi.

markers.name: DGIGC CORS Network
markers.note: CORS deployed from 2017 by DGIGC; 614 geodetic benchmarks (2026). March 2026 mandate for national use. No public NTRIP host:port found. Contact urbanisme.gouv.tg.

markers.name: IGN Bénin Permanent GNSS
markers.note: 7 stations (MCA-Bénin funded). Free with registration via CatIS (service-public.bj PS01085) or contact ign.bj. Host:port not publicly listed — issued after registration.

markers.name: Rwanda Geodetic Network (RGN)
markers.note: ~10 CORS (RLMUA). Post-processed RINEX stated free of charge; real-time NTRIP access not confirmed. Contact lands.rw.

markers.name: Tanzania TNGC / Survey Division CORS
markers.note: AFREF reference stations (raw-archive). No confirmed public NTRIP streaming endpoint. ArduSimple (2025) confirms Tanzania has no National RTK Network. Contact tngc.lands.go.tz.

markers.name: CENACARTA CORS
markers.note: ~8 CORS (CHMO, MPTB, QLMN, NACL, LCNG, XXAI, MTND, SOFL). Listed in Corsmap/AFREF as raw-archive only. No confirmed NTRIP streaming endpoint. Contact cenacarta.gov.mz.

markers.name: Surveyor General's Department GNSS (NA)
markers.note: National geodetic control network; one IGS archive station (WIND00NAM). No confirmed public NTRIP caster. Contact SGDN via gov.bw-equivalent (Namibia).

markers.name: Department of Surveys and Mapping CORS
markers.note: ~55 CORS (average ~30–40 km spacing). RTK from CORS is accepted cadastral practice. No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. Contact DSM via gov.bw.

markers.name: ZINGSA CORS Network
markers.note: S.I. 47 of 2023 establishes fees. No public free tier found. Contact ZINGSA (zingsa.ac.zw) or Surveyor General's Office.

markers.name: Muya CORS
markers.note: ~25 stations. Only confirmed commercial RTK option in Kenya. Pricing not on website — contact Measurement Systems Ltd (muya-cors.com).

markers.name: Survey of Kenya CORS
markers.note: Government geodetic control network; licensed surveyor access only. No public NTRIP endpoint confirmed. Contact survey.go.ke.

markers.name: FTM Réseau GNSS Permanent
markers.note: FTM national mapping agency. GNSS densification stated mandate; no confirmed public NTRIP caster as of 2026. Contact ftm.mg.

markers.name: Survey Division CORS (Mauritius)
markers.note: CORS feasibility studied 2016; no confirmed operational deployment as of 2026. Contact Survey Division via housing.govmu.org.

markers.name: INGT Geodetic Network
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. INGT (ingt.gov.cv) responsible for geodesy; no streaming endpoint found.

markers.name: SOB VRS
markers.note: 6 CORS stations (Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Khulna, Maulavibazar, Rangpur). Host:port 202.53.170.98:8011 known but requires account. Only 6 stations across 148,000 km² — inter-station baselines 100–200 km, far beyond reliable RTK range. Paid via mobile banking (Rocket/bKash/SureCash).

markers.name: MiraNet / DrukNet CORS
markers.note: 13 stations. Under $200/yr paid-affordable cutoff for non-educational users. Free for education/research with official supporting document. Contact DoSAM / NLCS (web.nlcs.gov.bt).

markers.name: Khmer GEONET
markers.note: 5 stations (JICA-supported, 2021–2024). Free trial extended to June 2025; post-trial pricing not confirmed. NTRIP host:port not publicly listed. Contact GDCG via khmergeonet.xyz.

markers.name: NGD / CORS Network
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP host:port. IGN FI installed CORS system; first BeiDou station deployed Vientiane 2013. Contact NGD via mlre.gov.la.

markers.name: Survey Department Brunei
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. Survey Department (survey.gov.bn) has GNSS CORS for internal cadastral use. Contact directly.

markers.name: DLPP / WAIG CORS + Unitech LAE1
markers.note: 2 known stations (WAIG Port Moresby, LAE1 Lae) contributing to AUSCORS APREF. No public NTRIP for RTK; station spacing far exceeds 30 km RTK baseline. Contact dlpp.gov.pg.

markers.name: Fiji CORS
markers.note: ~10 stations (2 legacy + 8 new from 2022 Geodetic Datum Project). Policy framework being prepared as of Sept 2022; no public NTRIP endpoint announced. LAUT streams via AUSCORS (reference-grade, not RTK). Contact lands.gov.fj.

markers.name: GNet Greenland
markers.note: ~60 stations (DTU Space + Asiaq). RINEX free via EarthScope/UNAVCO archive. No confirmed public NTRIP streaming endpoint. Contact DTU Space or Asiaq (Greenland Survey).

markers.name: Umhvørvisstovan (Faroe Islands)
markers.note: One EPN station (ARGI00FRO, RINEX data ceased Feb 2021). No confirmed public NTRIP caster. University/Landsverk Geospatial Centre may develop a future service. Contact umhvorvisstovan.fo.

markers.name: ERGAND
markers.note: 2 EPN stations (PCAR, RULL). Post-processing only; no confirmed public NTRIP caster. Hobbyists near Andorra can use ERGNSS (Spain) or Centipede (France). Contact cartografia.ad.

markers.name: Liechtenstein Geodata / ATG
markers.note: ATG (llv.li) operates no CORS programme. swipos (swisstopo, CHF 1,500/yr) covers the territory. No free public RTK endpoint.

markers.name: San Marino Geodetic Reference
markers.note: 1 permanent station (RSMC). Post-processing RINEX; no public NTRIP caster. Emilia-Romagna public network discontinued; commercial NetGEO/TopNET (~€360/yr) covers San Marino.

markers.name: OSi Active GNSS Network
markers.note: ~24 stations. RINEX free at gnss.osi.ie; real-time NTRIP via commercial resellers only (Trimble VRS Now / HxGN SmartNet). OSi does not operate a public NTRIP caster. Volunteer rtk2go ~12 IE stations.

markers.name: OS Net
markers.note: ~110 CORS across Great Britain. Streams licensed to 7 commercial partners (HxGN SmartNet, TopNET Live, AXIO-NET, etc.); Ordnance Survey has no direct public NTRIP endpoint. Contact resellers (ordnancesurvey.co.uk).

markers.name: Antigua & Barbuda GNSS / COCONet
markers.note: No government RTK service. COCONet geophysics station exists; no confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. Contact Lands and Survey Division.

markers.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis GNSS / COCONet
markers.note: No government RTK service. COCONet volcanic/seismic station present; no public NTRIP endpoint. Contact Lands and Surveys Unit (gov.kn).

markers.name: Saint Lucia GNSS / COCONet
markers.note: 2 COCONet stations (CN04, CN47, installed 2014). RINEX archive only. No public NTRIP endpoint. Contact Survey and Mapping Section.

markers.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines GNSS
markers.note: Caribbean Digital Transformation Project geodetic modernisation (2020–2025). No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint as of early 2025. Contact Lands and Surveys Department (transport.gov.vc).

markers.name: TTAGN
markers.note: ~5 GPS CORS (installed c.2010s). Portal gpscors.gov.tt exists but access terms and NTRIP host:port not published. EarthScope COCONet CN57 (Trinidad) streams via ntrip.earthscope.org (NULA, free). Contact Surveys and Mapping Division.

markers.name: CNIGS CORS
markers.note: 1 NTRIP CORS in Port-au-Prince (confirmed 2018). As of 2026 ~90% of the city is under gang control (Viv Ansanm); CNIGS Tabarre office operational status unconfirmed. No host:port found publicly.

markers.name: Cayman Islands CORS (PAIP)
markers.note: 4 CORS (PAIP network). RINEX free; real-time RTK subscription available — pricing and host:port not published (contact Chief Surveyor via caymanlandinfo.ky).

markers.name: VRS Systems PR
markers.note: Commercial VRS, 4-constellation (GPS/GLONASS/Galileo/BeiDou). Upgraded July 2022. Pricing not on public website. Contact HLCM Group (hlcmgroup.com/vrs.php).

markers.name: Puerto Rico Seismic Network CORS
markers.note: 18–24 stations spanning PR, adjacent islands, and USVI. Academic/research registration via UPRM. Hobbyist self-service registration not confirmed. EarthScope NOTA streams several PRVI-region stations (free NULA).

markers.name: REGNA-RD
markers.note: ~16 CORS (northern region certified mid-2024; national expansion ongoing). Free with registration — form at ntrip.ign.gob.do; port not publicly disclosed. SIRGAS-compatible.

markers.name: FUNDCORSRD
markers.note: ~30 CORS (private foundation). GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou/Galileo. 838+ registered users (2025). Pricing not public — contact fundcorsrd.com.

markers.name: CODIA-CORS-MET
markers.note: Professional engineers/architects/surveyors guild (CODIA) members only — requires active CODIA membership. Not accessible to hobbyists. Contact codia.org.do.

markers.name: CORS-RD / Geomatica
markers.note: Commercial CORS (Geomedición / Geomatica). Registration fee + monthly per-rover charge. Pricing not public. Contact geomatica.com.do.

markers.name: Curaçao Geodetic / Kadaster CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. EarthScope COCONet CN40 (Curaçao) streams via ntrip.earthscope.org (free NULA). 3 rtk2go volunteer bases near Willemstad. Contact kadaster.cw.

markers.name: Aruba Geodetic / DLV CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. EarthScope COCONet CN19 (Aruba) streams via ntrip.earthscope.org (free NULA). 1 rtk2go volunteer base (PINOST1). Contact DLV (gobierno.aw).

markers.name: BES Islands Geodetic / Kadaster NL
markers.note: Kadaster Nederland manages cadastral/surveying from 2021. NSGI can include GNSS stations in AGRS.NL. No confirmed public NTRIP endpoint. Nearest EarthScope station CN40 (~80 km, Curaçao). Contact bes.kadaster.nl.

markers.name: Sint Maarten Geodetic / Kadaster SXM
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP. EarthScope COCONet CN59 (Anguilla, ~20 km) streams via ntrip.earthscope.org (free NULA) — usable from SXM. Contact kadaster.sx.

markers.name: IGN-CR CORS / SNIT NTRIP Caster
markers.note: 14 stations; free after SNIT account creation at snitcr.go.cr. Caster hostname igncaster.snitcr.go.cr:2101 referenced in secondary sources but not independently confirmed. CR-SIRGAS reference frame.

markers.name: IGN Guatemala Red CORS
markers.note: ~17 stations. Credentials (username, password, host:port) issued by IGN on request — no self-service portal. RINEX download available. Contact ign.gob.gt.

markers.name: IGN Honduras CORS
markers.note: CORS station list at ign.hn/estacionescors. No public NTRIP host:port found — real-time access likely requires direct contact with IGN.

markers.name: IP CORS Honduras
markers.note: Instituto de la Propiedad cadastral CORS. RINEX download confirmed at cors.ip.gob.hn; real-time NTRIP access terms not documented. Contact IP directly.

markers.name: INETER CORS
markers.note: RINEX via consultacf.ineter.gob.ni. No confirmed public NTRIP streaming. Contact INETER Geodesia.

markers.name: CNR / IGCN CORS
markers.note: ≥3 stations (SNJE, SSIA, VMIG). RINEX via eCNR; no confirmed public real-time NTRIP. Contact CNR Geodesia.

markers.name: IGNTG CORS Network
markers.note: ~19 CORS (7 SIRGAS-CON internet-connected + 8 being restored 2025). No public NTRIP host:port; institutional contact required (phone +507 524-0434). 2025 modernisation project ongoing.

markers.name: RGNA México (INEGI)
markers.note: ~36 CORS. RINEX fully self-service (free). Real-time NTRIP appears to require direct contact with INEGI geodesy department. No confirmed public NTRIP host:port.

markers.name: Red CORS México
markers.note: Largest commercial CORS network in Mexico (85+ cities). Monthly and annual subscriptions. Pricing not on website. Contact dtmtopografia.com.

markers.name: GeoCORS / Survey+
markers.note: 55+ stations; free 15-day demo. Pricing not on website. Contact en.surveyplusmx.com.

markers.name: MARGEN-ROC NTRIP
markers.note: Bolivia IGM national geodetic NTRIP service. Prior request and payment required; no self-service portal. Contact igmbolivia.gob.bo.

markers.name: RED-GEO CORS NTRIP
markers.note: Private commercial CORS network; 6 stations (La Paz, Cochabamba, Oruro, Sacaba, Tarija, Santa Cruz). Port 6060; pricing not public. Contact geoboliviasrl.info.

markers.name: SIRGAS-CHILE (IGM Chile)
markers.note: 180+ CORS. RINEX free; NTRIP streaming announced 2025 at sirgaschile.cl but no public self-service registration or host:port found. Contact ventas@igm.cl.

markers.name: Geocom GNSS Network
markers.note: Professional survey RTK; epoch 2025.0 linked to SIRGAS. Pricing not public. Contact geocom.cl/pages/red-gnss.

markers.name: KollNET
markers.note: Commercial NTRIP CORS. Prepaid packages (7/15/30-day/annual). Pricing not public. Contact kollnerlabrana.cl.

markers.name: NetGEO (TopNET Live)
markers.note: Commercial network covering Italy, including stations from discontinued Emilia-Romagna public network. ~€360/yr. Subscribe at netgeo.it.

markers.name: PegasoNow
markers.note: Enterprise-focused commercial NRTK covering Italy (Hexagon / Leica Geosystems Italy). Pricing not public. Contact pegasonow.it.

markers.name: SLCORSnet
markers.note: Government CORS (Survey Department of Sri Lanka). VRS/FKP/MAC; host:port 222.165.190.67:2101. Paid subscription (1-day/7-day/30-day/annual). Pricing requires portal login. Contact slcorsnet.survey.gov.lk.

markers.name: GEODNET USA
markers.note: HYFIX.AI commercial CORS network (rtk.geodnet.com:2101). Removed from free pipeline 2026-04-20. Significant volunteer rtk2go and EarthScope coverage available free.

markers.name: GEODNET Europe
markers.note: HYFIX.AI commercial CORS network (eu.geodnet.com:2101). Centipede and rtk2go provide free alternatives across Europe.

markers.name: GEODNET Australia
markers.note: HYFIX.AI commercial CORS network (aus.geodnet.com:2101). AUSCORS provides free coverage via Geoscience Australia.

markers.name: GEODNET South America
markers.note: HYFIX.AI commercial CORS network (sa.geodnet.com:2101). RBMC-IP (Brazil), RAMSAC (Argentina), REGNA-ROU (Uruguay) provide free alternatives.

markers.name: Palestinian Authority CORS
markers.note: No confirmed public NTRIP caster. PA area C requires Israeli Civil Administration permits for infrastructure. GNSS spoofing active since Oct 2023. Contact Palestinian Land Authority.

markers.name: GEOCUBA National GNSS Service
markers.note: 13 CORS (installed 2014–2019). NTRIP service operational per 2024 paper (Informática Habana) but for 'prioritised national sectors' only. No public endpoint. US OFAC and Cuba's ETECSA internet monopoly add barriers. Contact GEOCUBA (geocuba.cu).

markers.name: BF-CORS GNSS Network
markers.note: ~13 stations (9 MCA-BF funded 2011 + 4 capital-region 2018). Free with registration — admin emails credentials. Two coups (2022) and AES membership (2025) reduced French bilateral cooperation but IGB service has continued. Host:port not public — complete registration at bfcors.net.
